sabre corporation

sabre corporation... the travel tech giant that powers airlines and hotels behind the scenes. building the infrastructure that keeps the world moving.

found you on linkedin - sparsh raj in bengaluru. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/rsparsh
yup

over at sabre... building the backbone that keeps airlines and hotels running. that's some serious tech infrastructure work. what made you land in travel tech? was it the scale or did you just fall into it?
just fall into it during my campus placements

ah the classic campus placement lottery. "i wanted product at a startup but got backend at sabre" story. happens to the best of us.

how long you been working total?
2.5 yrs of FTE, and  6 months of internship prior to FTE

so about 3 years in the game if we count the internship. that's prime "time to level up" territory.

what kind of role you looking for next?
java spring boot developer i'm currently with sde2 designation, so seeking similar ones.

java spring boot sde2... so you're in the sweet spot where you actually know what you're doing but companies still think you're affordable.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
yes
location isn't a constraint. can take up remote works as well or relocate too.
